title: What Godly Self-Control Actually Looks Like (It's Not Willpower)
caption:
Guys treat self-control like a fight they have to win in the moment, gritting their teeth against the urge at 1 AM with nothing left in the tank.

That's not what it is. Real self-control is decided hours before the moment ever shows up: the phone left in another room, the boundary said out loud, the brother who gets the text before the scroll instead of after. Paul talked about disciplining his body like an athlete in training, not just on fight night. The small no's are the reps. The big no is just the payoff.

What's the boundary you keep meaning to set at noon instead of fighting it at midnight?

#faith #selfcontrol #discipline #christianmen #manofgod
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
